text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Running by the water feels so good.
The wind is cool, and there's a lovely scent—...?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! We've got a situation...!
I spot a kebab stall over there!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Kh, what an appetizing aroma...
Trainer, what should I do...!
choice_data_list: Let's run straight through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Until this scent fades away and disappears
from my memory... I'll keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We will definitely meet again someday...!

"Shedding sweat and tears, Oguri Cap
kept running relentlessly... and as a result,
her weight had returned completely to normal."
